abilitydescription.p:
Alchemy is concerned with the creation of chemical substances, the creation of cures for various diseases, the creation of solvents (acids), liquid fire, dies, gunpowder, etc.
A character with the Alchemy ability has the necessary ingredients they can check to manufacture acids, dyes, blackpowder, inks, poultices etc. They can identify many chemical substances. In need they may be able to substitute some substances during creation to make solutions of lesser strength. Possesion of relevant equipment such as a Mortar and Pestle should provide a bonus to the Check, at the GM's discretion.

The ingredient used to manufacture these items may be expensive. Furthermore they may have a limited shelf life as moisture in the air and internal alchmical reactions can reduce the efficacy of these items over time. For these reasons alchemical creations are often created before embarking on an endeavour and any unused items are discarded afterwards.

Mechanically, the Craft check id a deferred check and works as follows: the character declares that they will craft a particular item while they have access to their lab. They then make the check to succeed at a later time when they finally go to use the formulation. The check should be made with disadvantage if the formulation is old (does not apply to black-powder).
In addition the character can make lore checks to recall knowledge regarding the chemical composition of solutions, metals etc and might be able to conjecture on their origins and purposes.
Two, as yet, unattained goals of alchemy are the transmutation of lead into gold, and the creation of an elixir of immortality.

tablerow.td: Dyes, Blackpowder, Inks, Poultices
Strong Acids: see Oil of Vitriol, Aqua Fortis, Spirit of Salt, and Aqua Regia.
Limaceous Grease requires Ichor of a demon
Various medicines, Poisons, War-Fire, Foaming Plaster, Coloidal Silver
Smoked Snigglets requires Fresh raw swamp snigglets
Tears of Lethe requires Laudanum
Alkahest requires Bile of the White Worm
Potion of Living Death requires Serpents Venom
Ignis Sacer requires Moldy Bread

abilitycheck.name: Missile Attack
abilitycheck.critfail: Roll on the ranged consequence table

abilitydescription.p: The character is trained in the use of artillery in sieges or naval warfare. They can arm, aim, fire and on some occasions repair artillery pieces.

The character has studied the history of antique objects, furniture, vases, coins, maps, swords, etc. They can check to evaluate the worth and provenance of these objects. At higher ranks they can, with difficulty, discern the nature of certain well-known eldritch objects.

Book keeping encompasses accounting and financial abilities. Book keeping is used by merchants, clerks, and castellans, to manage finances. With this ability an character can examine the books of a business to get an idea of how the business operates, whether it is doing well or badly, how much debt is owed if any, where the money is coming from and going to, and so on.

abilitycheck.name: Library Use Check
abilitycheck.precondition: Access to a library containing pertinent information.
abilitycheck.critsuccess: +9 to the skill result for Knowledge Checks made in the library.
abilitycheck.righteoussuccess: +6 to the skill result for Knowledge Checks made in the library.
abilitycheck.success: +3 to the skill result for Knowledge Checks made in the library.

abilitydescription.p: The character has had access to and has read some books. They have a broader understanding of the world than their less educated peers.

abilityauxiliary.name: Grand Discovery
abilityauxiliary.precondition: Can make this check once for each rank gained in this ability. The character must have access to a laboratory in order to do make this check.

abilitydescription.p: The alchemist makes a Grand Discovery!! (maybe). Every time the character gains a rank in this ability roll 2d12 on the Grand Discovery table. If the character makes several Grand Discoveries and receives a duplicate result then they reroll, except for the Disappointment, Transmutation and Surprise Discovery results. Mastery for this ability is one, so the character only needs to make this check once before being able to gain the next rank of this ability. Only one check is allowed per rank. It takes the character 3d4 days to perform the applied experimentation for this check, for which they require a suitably equipped laboratory. This experimentation must be done prior to making the check.

tablerow.td: Possession. The character becomes possessed!
Untamed Brute. The characters brutish nature comes to the fore at times of stress. Gain the “Untamed Brute” Aspect.
Disapointment! No discovery made
Unexpected Discovery. Gain a rank in alchemy.
Poison Resistance, +5 to saves vs being poisoned.

Transmutation. After years of practice you finally are able to transmute lead into gold. Unfortunately you can't work out how to repeat the process. Fortunatly you transmuted a lot of lead the first time.
Arcane Knowledge. Gain 1x promotions in magic and 2x promotions in fine arts, lore or special abilities (promotions cannot be used to gain more Grand Discoveries)
Enhanced Ability: Roll d6 on a 1: Gain Speed +2, 2: Gain Str +2, 3: Gain Agility +2, 4: Gain Perception +2, 5: Gain Endurance +2, 6: Choose. This change is permanent
Elixir of Life. The alchemist has somehow ceased their own aging.
Forbidden Knowledge. Gain 3x promotions in magic and 3x promotions in fine arts, lore or special abilities (promotions cannot be used to gain more Grand Discoveries). Gain a Patreon.
Surprise Discovery. Choose a Grand Discovery - no duplicates allowed.

abilitydescription.p: History is the study of the events of the civilized peoples. Its study is both interesting and useful.

An understanding of the law grants the character insight into the way society works. The practice of law invariably leads to the heart of industry and the seats of power. Characters may be able to discern the motive behind political machinations and they may be able to cite a legal precedent in order to compel or cease certain courses of events in a civilized society.

Law is the study of the laws of a particular society. The study of the laws of one society is not necessarilly applicable to another. When choosing the law ability the player must specify which legal system they are studying.

At first rank this represents having a good, but not professional, understanding of the law of some land. Usually, the characters homeland. At higher ranks this ability represents a professional rank of understanding of the law, and some understanding of the laws in surrounding regions.

Maths is the lingua franca of science. A basic understanding of maths is a prerequisite for many other abilities. It can be applied in a very large and diverse range of circumstances including cryptography.

The study of nature. The character has some knowledge of the flora and fauna. They may identify many plants and may know about useful herbal remedies for certain diseases or for use in the the making of poultices. They have some understanding of zoology and anatomy. They may be able to identify interesting information about natural beasts.
Natural History is related to Survivalism. The former is more technical, based on oral or written sources, the latter is more practical and applicable in the wild.

The study of religions, their belief systems, rituals and history. At rank 1 the character has some knowledge of religious philosophies, legends and lore. At higher ranks the they can identify most religious symbols and quote from their texts. In order to cast clerical spells the character also needs Theurgic Lore which deals which deals with the mechanics of theological spell casting.

At rank 4 the character has a deep knowledge of numerous religions both living and dead. The characters depth of knowledge is deep enough that they may pass as a follower of many faiths when questioned.
At fifth rank the character can enter a trance that releases stress, appears as if the character is dead, can reduce the characters oxygen consumption, and reduce the effect of poisonous miasmas.

The character is a specialist medical diagnostician. They are responsible for diagnosing what is wrong with people and balancing their humours. Their treatments include modifying the diets of their patients, proscribing, but not creating, ointments, tinctures and potions, and the medicinal application of leeches.

Physics involves the study of the natural laws of the universe, movement and energy, celestial mechanics, astronomy and meterology. Its practioners usually make a clear deliniation between the study of physics and the study of the wyrd, unworldly and unnatural laws (possibly to protect themselves from pogroms and witch hunts).

This ability represents the study of the machinations that occur in the upper ranks of power in society, its application, its history and its heraldry. This includes political theory: Real Politics and Machiavellian dealings and important historical treaties and maneveurings.

At first rank the character has knowledge of the history and current affairs of some local regions nobility and royalty. They know the heraldic insignias of these nobles and important state organizations. They understand the laws of succession in that region. They know most of the commonly known court intrigue and have a decent understanding of the machinations and manoevering of the ruling classes.
At each rank above the first the character gains this understanding for a new Society.
The character knows how to make magical potions given a lab, time and the right ingredients.

abilitycheck.name: Smoke Bomb Supply
abilitycheck.any-success: Defensive checks against missile attacks made at +2×Rank

abilitycheck.name: Petard Supply
abilitycheck.any-success: Defensive checks against missile attacks made at +2×Rank

abilitydescription.p: The character knows how create explosives. They keep on their person some explosive material at all times which may be used to create an ersatz grenade or petard. A grenade is an anti personal explosive thrown at a target which does an area of effect damage. A petard is a breaching charge used to blow a hole in a door or thin wall. When required the character makes a check. If unsuccesful the bomb is a dud and fails to ignite. If successful the bomb they are carrying lights successfully and performs as the equipment item of the same name. Note that these explosives are a little unstable, and a little unweildy. The character only carries enough ingredients to create one of these items, after which they must create more in their lab.

The character has learned to create smoke bombs and keeps upon his person a smoke bomb that he has previously created. When required the character makes a check. If unsuccesful the bomb is a dud and fails to ignite. In the event of failure further attempts at lighting the bomb may be made. If successful the smoke bomb they are carrying lights successfully creates a billowing cloud of grey smoke surrounding the bomb with a radius of on the first turn on the second turn and on the third turn.

This cloud gives +3×Rank to defensive rolls against missile attacks. It is clearly visible during the day, but may not be noticeable at night depending on the lighting. The cloud also provides +Rank against area-of-effect attacks. Note that after successfully lighting the bomb, the character must take a long rest before they can build another bomb which allows them to make this check again. Smoke bombs take time to prepare and are do not age well, so the character cannot produce a never ending stream of smoke bombs. Furthermore smoke bombs require a small amount of specialised equipment and the character must have access to this equipemnt to create smoke bombs. The smoke bomb may be thrown as if it were a rock. If the character uses a thurible this grants a +1 to the check and also allows the smoke bomb to be thown as if it were a sling (if not retrieved the thurible will then be lost).
